note: Cancel on client disconnect. dispatchAsync: an exceptionally completed CompletableFuture (cancel, orTimeout, completeExceptionally) now aborts the Rust handler and frees its vespera.async.maxInFlight slot; the proxy ASYNC mode cancels the native dispatch on Spring async timeout / container error / disconnect. JNI: the VesperaBridge.dispatchAsync symbol is replaced by AsyncDispatch.dispatch0 (returns a cancellation token) and AsyncDispatch.cancel0 (VesperaBridge.dispatchAsync keeps its Java signature; bridge JAR and native library must come from the same release). vespera_inprocess: new cancellable / cancel / cancellable_in_flight; vespera_jni: new async_in_flight and ASYNC_CANCELLED_MSG. Streaming modes (already dropping the response body on a failed client write) gain tests; SYNC/DIRECT remain bounded only by the dispatch timeout.
